provenance.sourceAccessMethod: Complete assigned HTML, ledger, independent check and research handoffs read locally; relevant retained primary extracts inspected. No web, new research, contact, application, publication or package build. Local scoped checker imports and arithmetic only.
provenance.originalResearchAccessLimitations: Early original generic fetch/search automatically used managed-browser/search routes without proven fresh storage. No supplied/imported/intentionally used credentials observed. Later decisive empty Chromium/anonymous HTTP reads support content but do not retroactively certify investigation-wide clean-session compliance. Earlier BOI TLS-bypass copies not final basis.
provenance.retainedEvidenceGaps: No raw AStG §2, EStG §50d, SGB IV §4 or KSK publication in retained evidence directory. Narrow adviser-screening/scheme statements follow the completed independent check of official instruments, not a fresh authoring source read. Saved BOI main body does not expose remote-worker category; independent check supplies current-summary review and conflicts. No exhaustive treaty/MLI or Gazette certification.
provenance.reviewReconciliation: Independent check supports DTV-first, all monetary arithmetic and day example, with explicit U01–U04 limits. This draft applies F03 subsidiary-direction caveat and F04 mandatory Germany submission/payment versus strongly advised remaining until decision. Later official RD treaty OCR supersedes earlier research-handoff nonofficial-mirror gap, not current-consolidation gap.

datePolicy: Source-specific primary-source access dates are November 7, 2026 as stated in the original ledger. The e-Visa/TDAC action endpoints have unknown successful-access dates and are not used as independently read substantive authority. Publication/effective dates are source-specific where stated, otherwise unknown. Copy editing does not refresh sources or certify 2027–2028 law.
uncertainties: U01: THB 1,900 DTV/ED/exemption extension amount not directly primary-verified; conditional totals only, no assured count or duration.
U02: no blanket statutory work-permit exemption verified for every DTV arrangement; Thai clients/local or mixed paid work need case-specific permission/advice.

U03: exact 2027 Chiang Mai DTV/ED extension/conversion eligibility, documents, financial seasoning, fee, lead time and reporting/TM30 workflow unresolved. No universal school year or Bangkok-to-Chiang-Mai checklist transfer.

U04: 2027 tax reforms and current treaty amendments/MLI consolidation not exhaustively established. Rival earning-year/following-year exemption and worldwide-without-remittance proposals not treated as enacted law; RD register last-updated August 3, 2026 limits negative evidence.

BOI summary versus detailed checklist: USD 50m versus more-than-USD 50m boundary and reversed subsidiary ownership wording; subsidiary/boundary cases need BOI confirmation. Does not cure missing freelance employment relationship.

Jonas-specific income versus turnover/profit, savings history, degree/IP/funding, employment facts, German dwelling/business access and return-work days, dates, policy status and income allocation missing.

No personal tax bill, filing-category/half-year determination, VAT/business-registration result or automatic treaty credit/exemption. Thai-performed services ordinarily Thai-source; domestic 180 days distinct from treaty 183 days.
No quoted medical premium, German contribution/Anwartschaft, tuition, advice, translation, travel or accommodation; no insurance return/readmission guarantee.
Historical original clean-session exception and retained raw-source packaging gaps remain explicit; no fresh source, legal completeness or release/render verification claimed.
editingContract: Only new batch28 slug JSON, English Markdown and batch28 slug notes. No Chinese page, shared/inventory/check/build changes; director renders link-free footer. No Review markup.
